questions.text: The Great Wall is a famous landmark of which country?
questions.explanation: The Great Wall was built and rebuilt across northern China over many centuries.

questions.text: Which African animal is a real high achiever, being the tallest land animal?
questions.explanation: Giraffes can stand about five metres tall, taller than any other land animal.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Japan?
questions.explanation: Tokyo has been Japan's capital since 1868.

questions.text: Which is the largest lake in Africa by area?
questions.explanation: Lake Victoria is Africa's largest lake by surface area.

questions.text: In which country is Mount Kilimanjaro found?
questions.explanation: Kilimanjaro, Africa's highest peak, lies in northeastern Tanzania.

questions.text: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.explanation: Nairobi is Kenya's capital and largest city.

questions.text: Which sea separates the Arabian Peninsula from northeastern Africa?
questions.explanation: The Red Sea lies between Africa and Arabia.

questions.text: Which desert spans parts of southern Mongolia and northern China?
questions.explanation: The Gobi is a large cold desert in northern China and southern Mongolia.

questions.text: The rupiah is the currency of which country?
questions.explanation: The rupiah is the official currency of Indonesia.

questions.text: In which African country is the historic city of Timbuktu?
questions.explanation: Timbuktu is a famous trading and scholarly centre in northern Mali.

questions.text: Which is the only landlocked country in Southeast Asia?
questions.explanation: Laos has no coastline; the other mainland Southeast Asian states all touch the sea.

questions.text: What is the capital of Myanmar?
questions.explanation: Naypyidaw replaced Yangon as the capital in the mid-2000s.

questions.text: The Mekong Delta lies mainly in which country?
questions.explanation: The Mekong empties into the South China Sea through a vast delta in southern Vietnam.

questions.text: Victoria Falls is shared by which two countries?
questions.explanation: The Zambezi forms the border between Zambia and Zimbabwe at Victoria Falls.

questions.text: Thimphu is the capital of which Himalayan country?
questions.explanation: Thimphu is the capital of the Kingdom of Bhutan.

spares.text: Which Asian country is nicknamed the Land of the Rising Sun?
spares.explanation: Japan's name, Nippon, means origin of the sun.

spares.text: The Dead Sea lies between Israel, the West Bank and which other country?
spares.explanation: Jordan forms the Dead Sea's eastern shore.

spares.text: What is the capital of Ghana?
spares.explanation: Accra is Ghana's capital and largest city.
